messages:
Sam K: quick heads-up — ran a quant bakeoff for Phoenix-13B on L40s tonight. results look inconsistent.
Sam K: TL;DR: AWQ via our TRT plugin shows a ~4.6% absolute MMLU drop vs FP16 baseline. GPTQ and naive INT8 paths match baseline within noise. vLLM AWQ run (same model/config) doesn't show the drop. :thinking:
Sam K: full artifact: s3://redwood-bakeoffs/phoenix13b/2026-03-19/
Maya P: can you paste the perf/accuracy table and the exact commands/containers used?
Sam K: yes — pasted raw outputs below.
Sam K: ```
# baseline (fp16, vLLM): MMLU 78.9, P95 latency 42ms, toks/s 220
# awq (trt plugin, l40s): MMLU 74.3, P95 latency 28ms, toks/s 460
# gptq (triton): MMLU 78.1, P95 latency 33ms, toks/s 380
# int8 (triton, quantize-eval): MMLU 77.8, P95 latency 36ms, toks/s 350
```
Sam K: trt invocation (container):
Sam K: ```
docker run --rm -e CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 \
  -v /models/phoenix-13b:/models phoenix-trt:20260318 \
  /usr/local/bin/trt-server --model /models --quant awq --trt-plugins /opt/trt/plugins
```
Jun L: do you have any plugin logs? TRT often prints silent warnings about kernel fallthroughs that change accumulation order.
Sam K: pasted the plugin log excerpt:
Sam K: ```
[TRT-plugin] WARN: plugin "awq_quant" falling back to generic kernel for aten::linear
[TRT-plugin] INFO: fp8-path activated for weight dtype=fp8
[TRT-plugin] ERROR: scale-map mismatch: expected 256 entries, got 254
[CUDA] WARNING: cuBLASLT fallback to generic GEMM for shape (2048, 4096)
```
Jun L: "scale-map mismatch" stands out. could be a serialization/packed-tensor layout difference between our quant exporter and the TRT plugin. also what CUDA/Triton versions?
Sam K: nodes are running driver 555.44, CUDA 19.0 runtime in host kernel. Containers were built from our trt base image: cuda=18.2 + TensorRT 8.7 + trt-plugin v2.2.
Ron C: mismatch between host driver and container CUDA minor versions can be okay, but symbol differences between CUDA 18.x and 19.x can cause plugin load surprises. also note the plugin was built against TensorRT 8.6 originally.
Maya P: interesting that vLLM AWQ doesn't regress. that points to either (a) plugin implementation bug (scale ordering), or (b) kernel numerical diff from fused kernels in TRT.
Sam K: i ran the same AWQ files via vLLM on the same L40 and got MMLU 78.5 — within baseline. so rule out quant exporter itself.
Jun L: next repro steps: 1) run TRT with TRT_LOGGER_SEVERITY=VERBOSE and capture trt plan debug 2) run plugin unit test that validates scale maps 3) try building plugin against cuda 19 and trt 8.7 exactly.
Sam K: i already re-ran with VERBOSE. attaching snippet (in s3). summary: plan deserialization shows no error, but plugin still emits the scale-map mismatch at runtime. i also tried forcing CPU fallback (set PLUGIN_FALLBACK=1) and accuracy returns to baseline (albeit slower).
Sam K: ```
# quick repro command that triggered the mismatch
/opt/trt/bin/trtexec --loadEngine=/models/phoenix_awq.engine --verbose --plugins=/opt/trt/plugins
```
Ron C: sounds like a plugin edge-case for certain layer shapes introduced by Phoenix's architecture (long rotary dims + grouped linear). could be an index overflow or mismatch in our AWQ packing logic.
Maya P: can we run a diff of quant packing bytes between the vLLM-exported AWQ file and the one Triton is loading? size and checksums?
Sam K: yes — checksum:
Sam K: ```
s3://.../awq_exports/phoenix13b_vllm.awq  sha256: a3f1...b7
s3://.../awq_exports/phoenix13b_trt.awq   sha256: a3f1...b7  # identical
```
Sam K: identical bytes => exporter not the issue.
Jun L: then plugin has a parsing bug: expects metadata length=256 but reads 254 — maybe a 2-byte short read due to struct packing differences (pragma pack?).
Sam K: created INC-2026 and attached logs + repro script. assigning to eng-ml (Jun) and eng-runtime (Ron).
infra-bot: deploy job started: registry.redwood/phoenix-quant:v2 -> staging (job id 67921)
Maya P: action items: 
- Jun: reproduce with plugin debug and try rebuild plugin with cuda19/tensorrt8.7 (priority)
- Ron: run an isolated CPU-compat plugin harness to exercise scale map parsing (we have a C++ unit harness in infra/tools/trt-plugin-test)
- Sam: upload exact engine + awq file to INC-2026 and leave the Triton container alive (do not rm)
Sam K: i'll keep the staging container up and attach ssh creds in the ticket. i'll also run a quick unit that dumps the scale table.
Jun L: ack. i'll aim to have a root cause hypothesis by EOD. :eyes:
Ron C: if plugin fix will take time, fallback policy: route AWQ requests for Phoenix models to vLLM (same nodes) until patch is rolled — update routing rule in console.
Maya P: good plan. can someone add a short note to the bakeoff doc with the observed 4.6% delta and mitigation (vLLM fallback)? i can update the summary.
Sam K: done — README updated in s3 and bakeoff dashboard. thanks all. :thumbsup:
